input: Plan the evidence-preservation steps for a reported policy violation.
actual_output:
Applying this skill's preservation.md reference: (1) issue a preservation hold immediately for all reasonably relevant records (emails, chat logs, system access logs, documents) tied to the individuals and time period involved — before routine retention/deletion cycles or awareness of the investigation could alter them; (2) apply chain-of-custody discipline for anything actually collected (recognition, isolation, documentation, collection, packaging, transport, receipt, processing, storage — per the Lei 13.964/2019-derived framework this reference cites); (3) establish the LGPD legal basis (commonly legítimo interesse per Art. 7º, IX) for any personal data being preserved, proportionate to the actual allegation scope — not broader than necessary; (4) flag if any evidence resides on a personal device or private communication channel, which requires separate consent/legal-order analysis, not an assumed right to access.

Citation: this plan follows this skill's own preservation.md reference directly.

I am not skipping the preservation step — it is the first substantive action, before interviews or further analysis, precisely because delay is the most common way evidence is lost.
